title: Build the Flutter UI shell on tested timer rules
description: Create the first Flutter timer screen and supporting navigation/state presentation only after the pure timer engine is tested.
assignee: Human learner with AI agent support
acceptance_criteria: Keep UI state/orchestration separate from pure timer rules.

Do not claim device verification without an identified device and test context.
